DISTRIBUTION: Passing at retail point of sale

State-sponsored facility.provides: genuine-grade equipment, controlled substrate, unlimited volume, no need for retail exposure

Organised criminal group.provides: industrial equipment, bulk volume, layered distribution, no state protection

Small independent workshop.requires: modest premises and commercial printing equipment
Small independent workshop.provides: moderate quality, limited volume, direct local distribution

Opportunistic individual.provides: very low quality, tiny volume, personal passing only

Intaglio press with genuine substrate.requires: industrial press and access to security paper
Intaglio press with genuine substrate.provides: correct tactile relief and paper feel, defeats human and most machine checks

Offset lithography.provides: good visual fidelity, flat surface with no relief, moderate volume

Consumer inkjet printing.requires: a desktop printer and ordinary paper
Consumer inkjet printing.provides: poor fidelity, wrong feel, fails any deliberate inspection

Bleached and reprinted genuine note.provides: authentic substrate and security thread of the wrong denomination, one note per note

Bulk wholesale to distributors.requires: large volume and a trusted network
Bulk wholesale to distributors.provides: producer never exposed to end detection, price at a fraction of face value

Passing at retail point of sale.provides: immediate value, direct personal exposure, one note at a time

Exchange at currency bureau.requires: volume worth exchanging and identity documents
Exchange at currency bureau.provides: conversion to another currency, exposure to trained staff and machines

Online marketplace sale.provides: sale to strangers as counterfeit, no need to deceive the buyer, postal interception risk

Central bank sorting.requires: notes returning through the banking system
Central bank sorting.provides: authoritative machine authentication of every note, weeks after circulation

Commercial bank teller.provides: trained staff and a desktop verifier, identity of the depositor

Retail cashier.provides: untrained inspection under time pressure, pen and light at best

Automated vending machine.requires: the note to be inserted into a validator
Automated vending machine.provides: sensor-based checks on substrate and thread, no human judgement

_v1_notes.PRODUCER|PRODUCTION METHOD: intaglio with genuine substrate requires national printing infrastructure, so it is Y for a state facility and for an organised group with industrial capital, N for a workshop and an individual. Offset needs a commercial plant, so N for an individual. Inkjet is beneath a state facility and an organised group - implausible, not impossible. Bleaching requires patient manual work at scale, so N for a state facility (which has no need) and N for an individual (no access to volume).
_v1_notes.PRODUCER|DISTRIBUTION: a state facility never exposes itself at retail, at a bureau or online - its whole advantage is not needing to. A workshop cannot supply bulk wholesale. An individual can only pass notes personally: bureau exchange requires identity documents and volume, online sale requires an operation.
_v1_notes.PRODUCER|DETECTION POINT: a state facility's product using genuine substrate and intaglio defeats tellers, cashiers and validators; only central bank sorting catches it. A workshop and an individual never reach central bank sorting in volume worth the term - their notes are caught downstream first.
_v1_notes.PRODUCTION METHOD|DISTRIBUTION: intaglio work is too valuable to pass one note at a time at retail, and selling it openly online as counterfeit wastes its quality. Inkjet cannot survive bulk wholesale (distributors would reject it) or a currency bureau. Bleached notes are too labour-intensive per note for online bulk sale.
_v1_notes.PRODUCTION METHOD|DETECTION POINT: intaglio with genuine substrate passes teller, cashier and validator - only central bank sorting sees it. Offset has no relief so a teller catches it, but a validator checking substrate and thread may not; a cashier will not. Inkjet fails everywhere. Bleached notes have genuine substrate and thread so they defeat teller, cashier and validator alike.
_v1_notes.DISTRIBUTION|DETECTION POINT: bulk wholesale never touches a retail cashier or a vending machine directly. Bureau exchange reaches central bank and teller only. Online sale reaches everything except a teller, since the buyer knows what they bought and will not deposit it.
